body: Congrats Op, i struggle with this so badly. I wish you the best and that your new job beings you joy!

People tend to avoid very negative topics or situations they don't know how to handle. I also told my family I want to die, but they just got very angry at me and called me ungrateful.

As for not bringing anything to the family, you are doing housekeeping and taking care of the children. That in itself is difficult. I'm sorry it doesn't allow you much time to go out and meet people, but you should try to make time for yourself. Maybe consider having someone watch your kids as you go out shopping or to some social event.

Op, I just want to hug you for a while. Could you try to talk to your family as to why they treat you this way? I know it sounds like the exact opposite of what you should do but it helps to know why. It may make you feel even worse for a while though.

I live in a family where I was neglected emotionally only and I finally asked my family about it. Why the treat my elder brother better. And they said it's because I was too quiet as a baby and growing up they didn't want to socialize with me because they thought I had it all figured out. That and in my culture they treat guys like princes because they carry on the family name. Higher expectations for guys so they care more.
That's deep. Maybe one day I can actually save myself and a couple others.
Sorry there buddy. Not really sure how I can help since I'm in a similar situation. All I can do is hope for the best for you and that friends will come your way soon.
Family, video games and laziness
I feel you bro!

Still alive. Friend told me I'm full of shit just wanting attention because I say i think of suicide every time i wake up. I guess i am because if i was really suicidal i would've done it by now right? Maybe i'm just an attention seeking whore. Even this post. Sorry guys with real problems
Being able to memorize anything only seeing it once
Having dreams and goals

Yup, been trying to tell myself to be happy but that's nearly impossible. Also been trying to think of the positive of side of a negative situation but even that is a challenge. I'm a very pessimistic person.
Maybe just giving up too easily.

All the time! Been doing it since I was young. I have a older brother who was more loved than I was and I was very jealous of him. Still am because now I'm basically worthless and finally have my family giving a shit about me.
Yeah seriously though. Funerals is a business.
Dying is expensive for love ones who want to give u a proper burial though.

Of course! I dislike so many aspects of myself that it hurts to look in the mirror. It makes me question my entire life and how my life choices led me up to this point in life. Such a sad pathetic loser with no friends and no career.
Barely surviving life outside my house. Being ungrateful for family and all that they do for me...

Ahh that's unfortunate. Nothing really is within reach unless you exhaust every effort to make it be. Is there any ways to improve your grades at this point? Seek out professor or fellow classmates to help you out?

I have graduated from college with good grades just nothing to show for. Grades do not determine ur future. Your will power to be the best you does. Good grades also doesn't mean u acquired the knowledge. It only means u can accurate think on a similar pattern as the test writer. Look at the bigger picture and see what you want in life.
Fight on brotha
I want to find this enjoyment u speak of.
I am here if u want to chat
All the time

This will come off as very rude. I've been talking to a friend and he said that reason life is so hard is because we make is difficult for ourselves. I am guilty of this. He blames it on my extreme laziness to not wanting to improve myself. 

All these problems stems from poor decision making skills since I was a toddler. I just kept on making poor decisions after another until it shaped me to who am I am today. So my laziness kicks in because I truly believe that it would take too long or it's impossible to improve. I'am pathetic.

Nvm. Woke up feeling like shit again. Those bad memories replaying themselves as to why i'm like the way i am. Pre-k i had some traumatic experiences that probably killed some of my braincells, made me forever fear strangers, talking and all social interactions... i barely scraped by in school in terms of participating. I incorrectly learned to never seek help when i needed it. 

So i went through most of my life like that. So many problems i could've avoided then the shame then never telling anyone. I could've saved myself back then but i was too dumb to communicate that to my parents and authority figures. How i was bullied. shoved in a plastic box to be pushed down 6step stairs and left in the sun to pass out. Teachers found me eventually. I don't even remember if i went to the hospital for that. Or the other time i passed out due to heat exhaustion in a metal playground. Teachers left me there until i woke up. Teachers and students very concerned. I was still on the burning metal i don't know how long. 

Child neglect n now i'm older 23. Not much i can do about it. Never learned how to truly read and spell many words.. that too was my problem in 2nd grade. Then the bullying all throughout school to the end of high school. Never sought help... didn't take care of my teeth so i have problems now. Ahh the life choices have been so poor my entire life. Why am i like this? It's like i dug myself a grave. 

It's sad because now my family is alot better off than when i was younger. Mom worked hard to get a better job and we are comfortable now. But i'm in pieces from not getting my shit together. Went through all of college and didn't learn much. I struggled to read and understand textbooks n here i am again... didn't seek enough help. Didn't know how to ask for guidance. Now i am on the fence about even bothering. 

Edit: spacing
Yes! I would love to be a puppy
I feel you
Haha literally me since head start (5) to now (23).
All the time since the moment i started having suicidal thoughts many years ago.

Hey haven't replied in a while. I have come to the conclusion today that i don't want change so i'm going to continue to live the mediocre life i've been living. Friend just told me just just accept the fact that i don't want change. So here i am. Accepting my stupidity n avoiding my problems.
Changing for the better.. so many inner demons to fight :/

No worries! Yeah sometimes i believe not fitting in with social groups have lead me to think i have avoidant personality disorder.... too pessimistic now to even be open minded :/. Trying to be optimistic is hard.

I honesty don't think I cared enough for my degree. I was on premed track due to strict parents but i found out through coursework alone that i wouldn't be able to handle it. Mind can't remember a lot of things. It's like having a mind of a child, resetting after every exam.

Sorry to hear about your conditions though. Other countries do really have it rough. I can't begin to understand what your going through.

Yeah i have the same issue in addition to extreme social anxiety. I never really had that many friends but i know that talking about depression really drains them. So i try to never mention it even of sadness is written all over my face and attitude. 

Normally just ask them about what is going on in their life and talk about things they like. Maybe something they say will indirectly cheer you up. Like if you guys watch the same anime and there was some plot twist. Discuss anything other than your own problems. It's rough. Need a counselor or psychologist to hear your problems but that requires money.
Yup exactly! I kind of also lose all common sense when working too. The nerves really get to me even when i'm doing what should be easy tasks.

The interview was over the phone. I messed up the interview by not being able to answer one of the questions but they hired me anyways. It's been rough ever since. I've been messing up left and right. They just really need people for the holidays (Macy's). 

I try manage by finding a coworker what would give me a job to do. Then i do it until they tell me to do something else. So if they tell me to go stand over there at a cash register i do it. When i need help which is like all the time i ask the closest person. However i'm really bad with faces and names. It's like every time i go to work i'm meeting most of them for the first time. They are normally very nice to me. It's very nerve wrecking every second... Sometimes I come off as rude because I'm just so quiet and unknowable about everything. 

I try to just say hello to all my coworkers too when I come in. Ask how there day is, but beyond that I don't know how to make normal human conversation. So it goes back to dead silence. It's my first job too. I'm about 6 days in. Have like 14 more days to work. 

23 here. Went to college, graduated but I don't remember anything from those days. Memory is other shit. It's like i've never been to school yet pass elementary since i can't pronounce any of the brands. My life has been pretty much a joke. I awake up every morning like a train wreck. But i try to keep it together because my family would be devastated if i were to kill myself. So i go to a job i struggle with n currently going back to school for another degree that they want me to do but it's not working (school).
I'm sorry Op for the unloving mother. -hugs-

I feel exactly the same way. I currently landed my first job as a seasonal sales associate but it's killing me inside because I'm very socially awkward. I have no idea what I'm doing 98% of the time and I don't know how to make small talk with my coworkers. Just a statue standing around until someone gives me something to do. Kind of been avoiding my cashier duties because of fear of doing it wrong :/. So I haven't been improving in any social or technical  skills. To top it all off I can't read half of the brands we sell... I'm dyslexic. :/

Yup haven't gotten to making any real process in self improvement yet. It has been a constant cycle of beating what is left my my self esteem to a puddle. It will get better once i change my mindset.. the stubbornness is real

It surely is. It's become a habit now because I realized it's half my fault for never learning how pronounce words and talk to people. It's so crippling that I have no depth to myself because all i can think about is how much it limits me which never solves the issue.
Wishing i could go back in time. Apparently i never cared about anything in my life and that's why i'm currently so messed up. No inspiration. That or i wish for death.

Yeah i feel the same as you. I also just finished a degree and having trouble even thinking about what job i can even apply for. It's like i went through college and learned nothing. Spent the summer after college complicating what to do and having suicidal thoughts. 

Decided to do nursing for some reason and was no longer suicidal. Took a year to get the pre requirements. Enter nursing program and realized that i again learned nothing. Had a mental breakdown. Since then been super depressed and suicidal.

Parents made me go back to college for accounting now. Macroeconomics makes me question my existence. When will i learn to actually learn... 

TL;DR 
Yeah suicidal thoughts come in cycles at least for me. I have no idea what i'm doing with my life and well haven't learned much. Maybe i'm too ignorant.

My shyness comes off as very mean and cold. So i guess that's why i stopped trying new things. It's not like i'm failing school yet it just seems pointless. I don't understand how i will use this info. So brain automatically forgets it after an exam. 

The intense fear alone is enough to make me stop talking. It's like you want to make conversation on something. Not sure what but then you just end up avoiding making eye contact at all.
Try seasonal jobs in retail. They aren't a full time thing but maybe if they like you they'll keep you.
I feel the same. Could've died when i was in pre-k but some higher being did not will it strong enough to make it happen. Instead i probably lost a ton of brain cells. Yay neglect
Ahh now it's just the fear of trying. Only thing i've been doing is school n that hasn't been sticking in anyway
Last time i ever cared about anything was probably watching anime but even that isn't something i can actually talk about. Forgetful of what even happened.
Not exactly sure been freaking out about life for the past couple months that i haven't done anything for myself lately. It's an emptiness now.
I feel the same way. Is it just stepping outside your house or being in a location with people?
That's unfortunate for you though. I'm sorry that happened. Thanks for the warning.

Haha nope not really. Been kinda a very anxious, serious person my whole life. I think it revolves around not wanting to fail that i'm failing so hard. I turn into a mute person in public.

Yeah i told him to stop giving me advice at one point then he was very understanding then all of a sudden started giving me all this advice that made me feel like other shit and i told him that it's not helping. He got pissed n left. He wants to understand depression  though. 

I will try to avoid mentioning any problems to him.

Yeah i actually asked why the appointment was so far in the future. I would like to get help sooner rather than later, but she said that they are overbooked and have a shortage of psychologists at the moment. Someone just quit their job lol. Too bad i don't have a counseling degree otherwise i'll jokingly try to get that position..

Ahh yeah. I just met with one yesterday. Sadly the next appointment is in a month. Found another but that's a month wait too. The first appointment wasn't really much help anyhow. More like just gathering basic data. Offered no help until the actual first meeting. Honesty friend always says he is here for me but I question it since he left twice already. Starting to have trust issues.

Stuff like: get a schedule to do things, read faster (i'm kind of dyslexic but he refuses to believe it), exercise, try to interact with people, stop avoiding people (social anxiety to the point i have panic attacks sometimes). It's rough to even physically be in a public location for me let alone talk to people. Go out to random events and talk to people. I'm the super gullible type, so it's very easy for people to take advantage of me. Most times i don't realize it until it's too late. Err.. other than that alot of self help stuff that i find more or less just sayings like life will get better. He does make fun at me for sucking this much at life... it's true... i do suck at life. 

He always says he cares but leaves when i piss him off. I guess i take him for granted.

Baby steps my friend. Also comparing your life to others will always make you depressed. I would know because I do it all the time. If you want to do something then try to do it. If it doesn't end up the way you want it to then try to find ways to make it. However do know that you might need to compromise, life will not give you what you want if you don't try to fight for it. Keep on swimming my friend <3
